newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss March trade shows 3.1 million Sfr surplus.
newsitem.headline: Swiss March trade shows 3.1 million Sfr surplus.

text.p: Switzerland's trade data showed a surplus 3.1 million Swiss francs in March from a revised 328.0 million deficit in February, the Federal Customs Office said.
Note - Original February deficit 332.1 million francs, imports 8,298.0 million and exports 7,965.9 million.
The figures exclude precious metals and stones, art and antiques. Including those items, the March trade balance showed a surplus of 34.9 million francs.
Those figures were based on exports of 8,791.5 million francs and imports of 8,756.6 million.
"Swiss foreign trade in March 1997 was positive overall. Exports and imports were stagnant in value terms, which resulted in a decline in both cases in real terms," it said.
But based on the same number of working days, goods transfers rose in both directions in terms of value and volume, it said.
It also said the prices of imports rose significantly more than the prices of exports, which led to a worsening of the terms of trade. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
